items.name: BC Cubing Comeback A 2021

venue.name: Walton Elementary School
venue.details: In the gym, with additional space in the nearby foyer and library space as well

items.information:
**As per BC's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/covid-19/vaccine/proof), all competitors and their (single) guest must provide proof of having received at least one dose of vaccination in order to enter the venue. As such, please do not register unless you will have had at least one dose of a vaccine before the competition date, as otherwise you will not be allowed to enter the venue nor compete. We will send registered competitors further details in an email when the government releases more details.**

Cubing solo over the pandemic has made us only too glad to host an actual, face to face, long awaited gathering for local and perhaps not so local cubers...so welcome to BC Cubing Comeback 2021-either A or B!

We the organizers of [Fraser Valley Open 2018](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FraserValleySpring2018) and [2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FraserValleySpringOpen2019) are thrilled to invite you this time to the heart of Coquitlam for a fun and safe return to cubing, competing and most of all connecting together!

Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new shifts** and there are things to be particularly attentive to.

Note that this is a **one of a pair of twin competitions**. We have not had twin competitions in BC before. Please see the [Twin Competition tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCCubingComebackA2021#16151-twin-competitions) for more information.

A small portion of each registration fee will be in support of the BC Fires Appeal with the Canadian Red Cross. Each dollar we donate will be matched by both the provincial and federal governments. Donations will be used for immediate and ongoing relief efforts as well as for long-term recovery and preparedness. Feel free to check out [the Red Cross page](https://www.redcross.ca/how-we-help/current-emergency-responses/2021-british-columbia-fires) for more information.

Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCCubingComebackA2021#16152-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/11vtCfK4waavNE_PUpHGQ12mZxPuTA6_Hrbd79cNUhd0/edit?usp=sharing).

Note: **Spectators (max 1 per competitor)** can attend for free.  Those aged 18+ are invited to consider not attending with a guest to help our venue capacity numbers stay well within WCA recommendations. **If you're not a competitor, or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.**

Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in with the additional ask that all attendees show 1) a negative test prior to venue entry or 2) that they have been fully vaccinated for 2 weeks prior. The WCA reserves the right in the event of a clear 4th wave in BC to cancel the competition outright. Significant updates such as these will be posted here on the website and emailed to registered competitors.

items.name: Jordan Fall Open 2021

venue.name: Omareyah School
venue.address: Omareyah School, Ayaman Ramdan St 3, Amman, Jordan
venue.details: It's a school theater in the ground floor of a capacity of 500 people

items.information: The Jordan Fall Open 2021 is an official speedcubing competition of the World Cube Association (WCA). Speedcubing involves solving the 3x3x3 Cube or similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors, regardless of experience and skill, but time limits will be imposed in order to keep to the schedule and complete the days on time. No previous experience of WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA rules.

items.name: Hurry Up Hutt Valley 2021

venue.name: https://www.fpsportsville.org.nz/
venue.address: Ricoh Sports Centre,  237 Taita Drive, Avalon,  Lower Hutt

items.information:
# The competition has been cancelled due to the new alert levels in New Zealand.

Hurry Up Hutt Valley 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
